scripts.restart: pkill -CONT -f '[n]ode src/index.js' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -TERM -f '[n]ode src/index.js' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; node src/index.js
scripts.off: pkill -CONT -f '[n]ode src/index.js' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -TERM -f '[n]ode src/index.js' 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'JUNIORSTIVEN BOT APAGADO'
scripts.pause: pkill -STOP -f '[n]ode src/index.js' && echo 'JUNIORSTIVEN BOT PAUSADO' || echo 'EL BOT NO ESTA ACTIVO'
